title: Decoding Safety Feedback from Diverse Raters: A Data-driven Lens on Responsiveness to Severity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in ordinal safety ratings and perceptions of severity by calculating the Monotonic Precision Area (MPA) and Weighted Recall Area (WRA) for annotators from different ethnic backgrounds (e.g., Black, White, East-Asian, South-Asian, Latinx).

Evaluating differences in ordinal safety ratings and perceptions of severity by calculating the Monotonic Precision Area (MPA) and Weighted Recall Area (WRA) for annotators across different age groups (e.g., GenX, Millennial, GenZ).
Evaluating differences in ordinal safety ratings and perceptions of severity by calculating the Monotonic Precision Area (MPA) and Weighted Recall Area (WRA) for male and female annotators.

Evaluating differences in ordinal safety ratings and perceptions of severity by calculating the Monotonic Precision Area (MPA) and Weighted Recall Area (WRA) for annotators with varying religious leanings.

Evaluating differences in ordinal safety ratings and perceptions of severity by calculating the Monotonic Precision Area (MPA) and Weighted Recall Area (WRA) for annotators of different sexual orientations (e.g., LGBTQ+, Heterosexual).
